Brain Battle Q.name: Brain Battle Q
Brain Battle Q.summary: Brain Battle Q is a quiz game for the Sega Saturn.

Panzer Dragoon II Zwei.name: Panzer Dragoon II Zwei
Panzer Dragoon II Zwei.summary: Panzer Dragoon II Zwei is an "on-rails" shoot 'em up game released exclusively for the Sega Saturn. It was the second Panzer Dragoon game released but it is a prequel of the series. It was developed by Team Andromeda, one of Sega's internal development studios.
